items.title: Emile Barnes and Paul Barnes Interview, 1959-10-01
items.q: Yeah, I played with Buddy Petit out there. We worked out on Shantown, Louisiana.

ctx.x: So we're all ready to start. I'll give my voice. This is Bill Russell and we're down at the home of Mealy Barnes and Paul Barnes on Louisa Street. Do you want to give your name Mr. Mealy Barnes, Emile Barnes? Mm-hmm. What is your full name? My full name is Emile Barnes. Any middle name or initial? Mealy Barnes. Oh. That's Mealy.
They're going again. You were talking, was it Buddy Petit you said you played with?
